_readme: Every locked door in the game, walked into. Two of them are M29's, and they are the
reason the milestone is not just bigger formations: every fight past the village is now
sized for two people, so a player who has not got a second sword must not be able to
reach one. The genre's own answer - Dragon Quest II hands you the Prince through the
story - and here it is a requires_flag on the two roads out.
A refusal is the hardest thing to keep honest, because it looks identical to a door
nobody tried: the player is still standing in the village either way. So each leg asserts
the DIALOG - the refusal saying why - and only then that the map did not change.
It also re-homes the barred keep gate, which used to be proved three times over in the
long scripts and is proved once here. Those scripts now recruit Rook where the warden
leg used to be, because the recruit walk only works from the spawn.
THE CONTROL lives elsewhere, deliberately and not by omission: nine sessions recruit
Rook and then walk through this exact west door, and into_the_cave walks the cave road.
A refusal proved with no control is a gate you cannot tell from a wall, so where the
other half lives is written down here rather than assumed. It is not in THIS script
because the walk back from the town does not put the player where the recruit leg
starts, and a script that counted its way there would be pinned to a walk speed.

steps.text: west along row 5 into the hollow road. It refuses, and the warden says why - one sword was enough for the village, and the road is not the village.
and the refusal REFUSED: still in the village, on the near side of a door that did not open
east along the same row into the keep's gate, which wants a key rather than a person
the barred gate sits in an alcove - wall above and below it - so back west out of the doorway before turning south. A short count, and safely one: the next door west is ten tiles away.
south to the bottom wall, then east along it onto the road out of the village - which is not gated, because the town is a place rather than a danger
and the third door: the cave road, at the far east of the town. South wall, east wall, then north with east still held - the gate is the row that gives.
refused too, and still in the town: both roads out ask the same thing

and that is where this script stops. THE CONTROL - the same doors opening once she is along - is not missing, it is everywhere else: nine sessions recruit Rook and then walk through this exact west door, and into_the_cave walks the cave road. A refusal proved without a control is a gate you cannot tell from a wall, so it is worth saying out loud where the other half lives.
